howItWorks.title: How Points Work
howItWorks.rule1: Earn 1 point for every HK$1 spent, calculated on the actual amount paid (after deducting promo codes or Space Wallet credits).
howItWorks.rule2: For every 100 points accumulated, HK$10 is automatically deposited to your Space Wallet with no action required.
howItWorks.rule3: Points earned from a purchase are credited after payment is completed and cannot be used for that order.
howItWorks.rule4: Using Space Wallet does not reduce accumulated points or affect membership tier.
howItWorks.rule5: New members receive 100 points upon registration, with HK$10 automatically deposited.
howItWorks.rule6: When an order is refunded, the points earned from that order are deducted accordingly.
